name: bmp280test

expect.contains:
BMP280 test
Temperature = 21.37 *C
Pressure = 100981.95 Pa
Approx altitude = 28.60 m

Temperature = 21.37 *C
Pressure = 100981.95 Pa
Approx altitude = 28.60 m

description: Adafruit's bmp280test, unmodified: the library finds chip ID 0x58 at 0x77 (SDO pulled up, as on Adafruit's breakout; the common purple modules pull it down and need the sketch's other begin()), reads the trimming parameters and sets normal mode at x2/x16 with the x16 filter and 500 ms standby (a measurement every 537.5 ms), then prints every 2 s. The room's 21.37 C and 1009.82 hPa come back as 21.37 *C and 100981.95 Pa (within the 0.16 Pa resolution at x16) and 28.60 m by the library's altitude formula, worked out by hand beforehand.
